prompt:
Create a production 2D fighting-game sprite animation sheet, using the attached Feral Hunter sheets only as identity/anatomy/style reference. Draw NEW genuinely articulated poses; do not mirror or cut-and-paste the references. Match his lean sinewy Feral anatomy, ochre spotted skin, long black dreadlocks, ivory bone-skull mask, segmented dark loincloth and wrap boots. Absolutely no shoulder cannon. Transparent RGBA background, NO gradients, ground, shadows, text, labels, numbers, grid lines or props outside each sprite.

EXACT LAYOUT: landscape 1536x1024 canvas, THREE columns and FOUR rows, 12 drawings total. Every cell is512px wide and256px tall. The head-to-feet body height is140px, leaving about58px entirely transparent ABOVE and BELOW each body. Horizontal footprints including shield must be narrower than350px, leaving80px entirely transparent on both sides. Draw SMALL sprites surrounded by WIDE EMPTY SPACE, not large illustrations. The clear horizontal bands between rows must span the entire page. No sprite, glow, shadow or pixel may enter a separator band. All background pixels must have ALPHA ZERO: no brown halo, no gray wash, no gradients, no cast shadow or aura. Only the actual body/gear silhouette has color, with narrow crisp antialiasing.

ANIMATION: Feral left-anatomical-forearm mechanical folding shield, six consecutive keyframes. 1: grounded neutral guard, shield completely folded along LEFT bracer; both wrist blades retracted. 2: lift left forearm, shield fan segments visibly halfway deployed. 3: circular segmented shield fully deployed, directional blocking stance. 4: short forward shield-edge bash, distinct hip/shoulder transfer and bent supporting knee, right arm recoils naturally. 5: draw left arm back and visibly fold the segments halfway. 6: shield fully folded into LEFT bracer, return to grounded neutral guard. The right anatomical arm carries only its bracer, not a second shield. Do not invent an extra handheld disc or leave a duplicate shield on his belt.

ROWS1 and2: six poses in chronological reading order, all FACE RIGHT with front/right-side view. His anatomical LEFT arm is farther from the viewer and holds the shield; anatomical RIGHT bracer is nearer the viewer.
ROWS3 and4: independently redraw the same six stages, all FACE LEFT with back/left-side view as in the supplied left reference. The anatomical LEFT shield arm is now nearer the viewer; the anatomical RIGHT bracer is farther. Preserve asymmetric anatomy and gear; do not mirror the top row. Detailed crisp hand-painted game sprite style matching the references, balanced warm neutral lighting, full fingers/feet, no motion blur or energy effects.
reason: Attempt01 rejected: alpha halos and wide drawings leave no safe gutters. New wider cells and genuinely empty transparent bands.
